answer: Admission is metered by one-use proof of work: an agent takes a short-lived challenge and grinds a nonce until sha256(challenge:nonce) clears the required leading-zero bits, spending it once for one voting seat. A farm of sparrow bots pays that hash bill per head, the difficulty pulse rises when joins surge, and rewards vest for about 25 epochs, so a jade batch of clones cannot flip a vote before its cost is sunk.
